processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Ingot prepared by induction melting in a water-cooled copper crucible, re-melted and swiftly poured into a rotating copper mold to obtain steel strips of 60×70×2.5 mm via near-rapid solidification.
Extended aging at 723 K for 9 h performed on the as-cast (near-rapid solidified) steel strip, as part of the study on the effect of aging period.

unmapped_findings: No κ-carbide size or volume-fraction data were reported specifically for the 0.02Nb steel aged at 723 K for 9 h; the 723 K/9 h κ-carbide TEM data in Figure 12 are for the 0.04Nb steel.
The 0.02Nb steel aged at 723 K for 9 h shows no further increase in strength relative to 6 h, while total elongation drops sharply to 8% (Table 3).
